d.seg: வாட்ஸ்அப் வீடியோ கால் பேசலாமா இன்ட்ரெஸ்ட் இருக்கா
d.tr: Shall we talk on WhatsApp video call, are you interested?
d.ctx: The expert introduces herself and asks if the user is interested in moving the conversation to WhatsApp. The user responds by asking for clarification.
d.j: The speaker is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp).

d.seg: த்ரீ ஹண்ட்ரட் பேப்பர் பண்ணனும் ஃபுல் நியூடாக பேசுவேன்
d.tr: You have to pay 300, I will talk fully nude.
d.ctx: The expert demands payment for a sexual service involving nudity. The user asks if she can hear him.
d.j: The speaker is demanding money in exchange for sexual content (nudity).

d.seg: டபுள் நைன் ஃபோர் த்ரீ சிக்ஸ் டபுள் நைன் ஃபோர் எயிட் ஃபோர் செவன் ஒன் சிக்ஸ்
d.ctx: The expert provides her phone number to the user. The user repeats the number back to confirm.
d.j: The speaker is providing a phone number to move the contact outside the app.

d.tr: Come, I have sent the scanner.
d.ctx: The expert mentions sending a payment scanner to the user. The user responds by saying hello.
d.j: The speaker is providing a payment ID/scanner for a transaction, linked to the previous sexual service offer.
